decision.rationale: TXN-007990 is a Harbour Media subscription charge of 8.38 EUR on card CRD-000240. It was made on 2026-09-28 and posted on 2026-09-29. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, about 25 days after posting, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone and has nothing in writing. No documents are attached, so there is no merchant cancellation confirmation and no effective cancellation date to compare with the charge date. Under recurring-no-proof, the next step is to ask the merchant for its cancellation records and the terms of the subscription.

proposed_actions.note: Please send your cancellation records for this card's subscription, showing any cancellation request and its effective date, and the subscription terms that applied to the 8.38 EUR charge made on 2026-09-28.
